raw_response:
Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a focal opacity in the right upper perihilar region (highlighted by the red box), which is consistent with early pulmonary infiltrates or ground-glass opacities often seen in the initial stages of COVID-19 pneumonia. While CT is more sensitive, such peripheral or perihilar opacities on CXR are recognized early manifestations of the disease.
